parts.gloss: one who is hard to ruin

words.gloss: one who is hard to ruin

literal: One who is hard to ruin that let one know, side having run evil deed he does not do if.
translation: Know that a man is safe from ruin if he does not go astray to commit evil deeds.
modern: ஒருவன் தவறான வழியில் சென்று தீய செயல்களைச் செய்யமாட்டான் என்றால், அவனுக்கு அழிவு வராது என்பதை அறிந்துகொள்க.
explanation: This couplet explains that avoiding evil deeds is the surest way to protect oneself from destruction. The phrase 'மருங்கு ஓடி' means running to the side or going astray from the righteous path. If a person refuses to deviate from virtue to commit evil, they become 'அருங்கேடன்', meaning someone whose ruin is highly unlikely. Thus, moral integrity is presented as the ultimate shield against downfall.
